title: Claude Code, Cowork or Chat? Use the Right One
description:
Using the same AI tool for every task is where results start to fall apart. 👀

Chat is for quick answers, ideas and simple writing.

Cowork is for collaborating on documents, strategies and projects with more context.

Claude Code is for building, analyzing, automating and turning ideas into something executable.

The skill is not “using AI”.

The skill is knowing which AI mode fits the job. 🚀

That is what separates random prompting from real productivity.

That is exactly what we cover in our free weekly AI classes: practical tools, real workflows and how to apply AI without wasting time.

🚀 Access the classes through the link in my profile.
